articles.summary: Firmonertinib has the potential to redefine first-line treatment in this underserved population as a once daily, oral, brain-penetrant, chemo-free monotherapy ALPACCA pivotal trial is designed to support potential accelerated and full regulatory approvals NEWTOWN SQUARE, Pa., Dec.
articles.title: ArriVent Announces First Patient Dosed in Global Pivotal Phase 3 ALPACCA Trial Evaluating Firmonertinib for First-Line Treatment of EGFR PACC Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
